quote: Any customer can have a car painted any colour that he wants so long as it is black.
note: He cut the menu to one dish. Sales hated it. Is this the real start of everything, before the line?

quote: If Ford does that he will be out of business in six months.
note: Love this. But who said it? "The general comment" is vague.

replies.text: Ford doesn't name anyone; it's his own summary of the reaction, written 13 years later. Good colour, weak evidence, so I left it out of the note's body and only used it in the In their shoes card.

quote: The first step forward in assembly came when we began taking the work to the men instead of the men to the work.
note: Isn't this just "assembly line"? Why does he make it sound like a philosophy?

quote: every second necessary but not a single unnecessary second
note: Creepy and brilliant at the same time.
resolved: Improved the note: section 3 (the card on tuning the speed)

quote: our prices are based on an estimate of what the largest possible number of people will want to pay, or can pay, for what we have to sell
note: Price set by what people CAN pay, not by what it costs. From the table: price −62%, output ×42 between 1909 and 1917.
resolved: Improved the note: section 2 (added the table)

quote: Our policy is to reduce the price, extend the operations, and improve the article.
note: Price FIRST. This is the opposite of how we price our app. Might be the whole answer to my question.
resolved: Improved the note: section 2, and the short answer at the top

quote: no one knows what a cost ought to be
note: If costs aren't fixed, cost-plus pricing is a guess dressed up as maths.

quote: it had been necessary to hire at the rate of about 53,000 a year in order to keep a constant force of 14,000
note: Wait. 53,000 hires to keep 14,000 jobs?? Then the $5 day wasn't (just) PR. I need to change section 4.
resolved: Improved the note: section 4 (rewrote it; v2 said PR stunt)

quote: There was, however, no charity in any way involved.
note: He says it himself: it's a business decision. "A low wage business is always insecure."

quote: (1) Married men living with and taking good care of their families.
note: So not everyone got $5. Who checked whether you "take good care" of your family?

quote: for that reason we buy one of every new car that comes out
note: Competitor teardowns in the 1910s. We've never once paid for a competitor's app and used it for a week. Should we?
